A suitable bed base

A slatted bed base (fixed or flexible) to provide essential support and maintain its structure.

Quality bed linen

To enjoy the full comfort and quality of your Hybrid mattress, here are our tips for a perfect setup and long-term care:

Installation

Unpacking: We recommend unpacking your mattress within 30 days of delivery.
Inflation: Once out of its packaging, it will take its final shape in just a few hours. We suggest waiting 2 to 3 hours before sleeping on it for the first time.
Airing out: A light "new foam" smell is normal after unpacking. Simply air out the room and, if you like, wash the white top cover to help it fade quickly.

Maintenance

The cover: The top part of the mattress cover (the white section) is removable and machine washable at 30°C on a delicate cycle. Air drying is recommended to keep it in perfect condition.
Rotation: Since our mattress is designed with a specific top-to-bottom support structure, there is no need to flip it over. However, we do recommend rotating it (head to foot) once or twice a year to ensure even wear over time.

The Adjustment Period
It is completely normal to need a little time to adjust! Your body typically needs 2 to 3 weeks to fully adapt to a new support system and for you to feel the true benefits of its comfort.
